text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The fruitful summer training camp has 
finally reached its last day. As I catch 
my breath together with Zenno Rob Roy—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Ah! Look, Trainer! Kris S-san is on 
TV...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the TV in the lobby, Symboli Kris S 
appeared to be holding a press conference.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Affirmative. Next race will be—the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I see! And moving on from there, would it 
be alright to look forward to the year-end 
'Arima Kinen' as well?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Yes—that is this year's ultimate goal.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: And—the Arima Kinen will be the last.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: "The end...? What do you mean by that—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I will retire... from the Twinkle Series 
after this year's Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Therefore, this is the "end."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: ...! I-In other words—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Are you saying you're retiring...?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Eh... What? No way, that's... that can't 
be...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh, Kris S...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For Zenno Rob Roy, Symboli Kris S was the 
senior she looked up to. Her sudden 
retirement announcement.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day, even on the bus ride back to 
the academy from the training camp, Zenno 
Rob Roy looked completely hollowed out.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Retirement...? Kris S-san is...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
This year's Arima Kinen is... my final 
race...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Beyond the windows shut tight for the air 
conditioning, the ceaseless chorus of 
cicadas still echoes through. ...As if 
crying out in regret over the passing of 
summer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Between academy life, training, and 
racing, the busy days of the Umamusume 
always seem to fly by in an instant.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So winter, too, is sure to arrive in the 
blink of an eye. Even the winter when the 
Jet-Black Monarch, Symboli Kris S, races 
upon the turf for the very last time.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Kris S-san. I—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after returning to the academy, Zenno 
Rob Roy headed back to the Miho dorms 
remaining almost entirely silent.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A LANE message arrived that night asking 
for tomorrow off from training. ...It 
wouldn't interfere with the schedule. I 
reply that it's totally fine.
choice_data_list:
'Just don't overthink it all on your own, 
okay?'

'Just don't overthink it all by yourself, 
okay?'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Next time we meet, I will definitely talk 
things through properly. With that 
resolve, I hit the send button—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And the next day. On the night of the day 
Zenno Rob Roy took off from training."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While working alone in the Trainer's 
office—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...I'm so sorry for taking time off out of 
nowhere.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Still... but I—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Kh, I wanted... to think. I thought it 
over, and—I came here after making up my 
mind.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I want to run in this year's Arima Kinen!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Please enter, I want to race against you, 
Kris S-san! Because this... is our last 
chance...!!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Please, Trainer. Please...! Because...!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: It's true admiration.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
She is my admired hero. Kris S-san is... 
to me.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
And yet, for it to end like this...! I 
don't want that!! J-Just once is all I 
ask—!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Even just once would be enough. I want to 
fight on the same stage as her...!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, of course, the Kikuka Sho comes 
first. If I can't prove I'm a strong horse 
girl there, I'll never even get to run in 
the Arima Kinen, and—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
As I am right now, it's presumptuous of me 
to even enter the same race as Kris S in 
the first place.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I will build up my strength. 
Past the Kikuka Sho, and in time for the 
Arima Kinen, without fail!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: So—!!
choice_data_list: Thank you for telling me, Rob Roy.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
choice_data_list:
Next up is the Kikuka Sho. And after that, 
the Arima Kinen!

Next is the Kikuka Sho. And after that, 
the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: —Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy answered sharply, her body 
trembling. ...Her own eyes spoke with 
utmost eloquence that it was not out of 
fear.
